verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long must I struggle with my thoughts, with sorrow in my heart every day? How long will my enemy win against me?
Look at me and answer me, LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death.
Then my enemy will say, "I have beaten him," and my enemies will celebrate when I fall.
But I trust in your faithful love. My heart is glad because you rescue me.
I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
